tof_isp.description: The ISP for a time-of-flight sensor whose phase frames come as the sensor sends them -- a burst of four, then a wait -- and go as a display takes them: a frame store keeps every frame that comes, and hands the core the newest four side by side whenever it asks. The core is the ToF pipeline of model blocks, tof_core by default; the store is np2hw's, its frames in external memory or block RAM. Everything but where the frames live is proved from its models.

pipeline.description: The model blocks behind the store, reading the four latest frames side by side: tof_core, or a design's own composite around it, with its ports.

implementation.description: Where the frames live: 'axi', external memory through mem; 'bram', block RAM.

base.description: Where the frames start in external memory: a region kept for the store alone, a 4K-rounded frame a slot.

slots.description: Frames the store keeps: the four read, and the slack for those that come while four are being read.

bit_depth.description: The word each signed sample rides in.

headroom.description: Bits of each sample's word above its sign, always zero: the sensor's.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: The sensor's phase frames, one reference phase a frame, as they come, each frame's size and count in its context.

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: What the core makes of the four latest frames, as often as it is taken, with the newest's context.

outputs.name: out_source
outputs.description: Which frame in the frames out were computed at, counted from reset.

outputs.name: cold
outputs.description: Fewer than four frames of one history are whole: nothing goes out.

outputs.name: overrun
outputs.description: Sticky: a frame came into a slot being read.

outputs.name: mem
outputs.description: The external memory the frames live in.

store.description: Every frame kept as it comes; the newest four handed on side by side, with the newest's context.

core.description: The four latest frames to depth: the frames as the store hands them, the context as it hands it, the newest's.
